name: tasklean
description: Task-scoped SSH and dataset reuse, reviewable prompt optimization, and measured Codex usage.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse task state and measure task efficiency.
interface.longDescription: A companion plugin and local launcher for Codex. The launcher offers focused code reads, durable notes, compact logs and account-limit visibility. The plugin adds an audit skill and passive prompt metrics. Potential token savings are not yet proven.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex LeanTask to audit this project’s context and explain what can be measured.
